label: B25-JTAG-UART
metadata_correction: 2026-09-07 metadata-only correction: received_at aligned to the actual dispatch message, reported_at aligned to the final handoff message, and implementation/source/head references fixed to the implementation commit a24a11dcddc3e0a6b709adcef0cc47d423802322; RTL, TB, model and validation conclusions are unchanged.
objective: 验证 Catapult SoC JTAG-UART bridge 的标准 req.addr[2] DATA/CONTROL 映射及 Avalon/FIFO 握手语义；仅在 focused TB 证明缺陷时修改 bridge。

implementation.rtl_result: 现有 lcvex_catapult_soc_jtag_uart 通过 focused TB；未发现缺陷，未修改 RTL。
implementation.model: 独立 behavioral Avalon JTAG-UART model，包含可注入 RX FIFO、TX FIFO/WSPACE、TX full waitrequest、host drain、AC 和 side-effect counters。
implementation.response_policy: bridge 接收一次请求；Avalon waitrequest 放行后完成一次；rsp_valid/rdata/fault 在 rsp_ready 前保持。
implementation.forbidden_workaround: 未使用或移植 address[13] / RISC-V workaround。

coverage: DATA/CONTROL +0/+4 distinct through req.addr[2] and Avalon address 0/1
DATA RVALID bit 15 and character bits [7:0]
CONTROL WSPACE bits [31:16] with AC bit 10 asserted independently
delayed waitrequest with Avalon controls held and no premature side effect
RX FIFO pop exactly once per accepted DATA read, including repeated characters
TX FIFO full/retry and WSPACE=0; one write side effect after host drain
asynchronous reset during blocked request, valid/control drop, post-reset reuse
no duplicate Avalon read/write or TX pulse

validation.command: sed -n '/module lcvex_catapult_soc_jtag_uart/,/endmodule/p' rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_top.sv | rg -n 'req\.addr\[2\]|req_addr_q|address|waitrequest|rsp_valid|rsp_ready|tx_pulse'; if rg -n 'addr\[13\]|address\[13\]|RISC.?V|VexRiscv' rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_top.sv tb/sv/lcvex_jtag_uart_bridge_tb.sv tb/sv/lcvex_jtag_uart_model.sv; then exit 1; else echo PASS; fi

iverilog -g2012 -s lcvex_jtag_uart_bridge_tb -o build/agents/T-20260907-040/jtag_uart.vvp rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_top.sv tb/sv/lcvex_jtag_uart_model.sv tb/sv/lcvex_jtag_uart_bridge_tb.sv

validation.checks: JTAG_UART_TEST PASS; pre-reset Avalon reads=7, writes=7, RX pops=3, TX pushes=6

validation.command: conda run --no-capture-output -n lcvex verilator --lint-only --timing --assert -Wall -Wno-fatal -Wno-UNUSEDPARAM --top-module lcvex_jtag_uart_bridge_tb rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_top.sv tb/sv/lcvex_jtag_uart_model.sv tb/sv/lcvex_jtag_uart_bridge_tb.sv

conda run --no-capture-output -n lcvex verilator --binary --timing --assert -Wall -Wno-fatal -Wno-UNUSEDPARAM --top-module lcvex_jtag_uart_bridge_tb -Mdir build/agents/T-20260907-040/verilator rtl/lcvex_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_pkg.sv rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_top.sv tb/sv/lcvex_jtag_uart_model.sv tb/sv/lcvex_jtag_uart_bridge_tb.sv && build/agents/T-20260907-040/verilator/Vlcvex_jtag_uart_bridge_tb

integrator_review.result: pass; parent SoC uses the focused FIFO model and checks full transcript, RX pop and DATA write/model event/bridge pulse exactly once
integrator_review.address_mapping: 0x09000000 -> DATA address0; 0x09000004 -> CONTROL address1; no addr[13] workaround

risks: focused model is behavioral and does not replace the vendor Avalon JTAG-UART IP; parent T-037 must connect the model in shared SoC validation.
full SoC/L0-L2 and physical validation remain outside this lane and must be run on the merged T-037 candidate.
vendor IP-specific waitrequest/readdata timing still needs confirmation in the later generated-IP/board path.
next: 集成者按 T-037 写集顺序合入本提交，在合并 SHA 上接入 SoC TB 并运行受影响 L0-L2；本 lane 不需要 RTL 修复或 QEMU/Quartus/板测。
